# A hand-written /metrics scrape in the form of vLLM v0.32.0 (prometheus_client's
# text format), for the tests of Client.Sample. These comment lines are valid in
# the format.
#
# Origin of each line, so the expected values in the tests are not read off the
# parser:
#   - the vllm: names are those of vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py at v0.32.0, with
#     the suffixes prometheus_client adds (_total on a Counter; _bucket, _count
#     and _sum on a Histogram);
#   - the gauge and counter lines are in the form of the real capture
#     spikes/s2b/results/gh200-1gpu/arms/A1-vr-hash/after-w0.prom (labels sorted:
#     engine, model_name), and the two prefix-cache values are that capture's;
#   - that capture holds no histogram, so the time-per-output-token lines are
#     written by hand in prometheus_client's Histogram form: the labels sorted
#     with le between engine and model_name, the +Inf bucket equal to _count.
#     The bucket bounds are shortened, and the values are chosen here: 250
#     finished requests, whose per-request means (seconds) add up to 12.5.
# The preemption counter is 7.0, chosen here.
# HELP vllm:num_requests_running Number of requests in model execution batches.
# TYPE vllm:num_requests_running gauge
vllm:num_requests_running{engine="0",model_name="m"} 2.0
# HELP vllm:num_requests_waiting Number of requests waiting to be processed.
# TYPE vllm:num_requests_waiting gauge
vllm:num_requests_waiting{engine="0",model_name="m"} 5.0
# HELP vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc KV-cache usage. 1 means 100 percent usage.
# TYPE vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc gauge
vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc{engine="0",model_name="m"} 0.75
# HELP vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total Prefix cache queries, in terms of number of queried tokens.
# TYPE vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total counter
vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{engine="0",model_name="m"} 3.310655e+06
# HELP vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total Prefix cache hits, in terms of number of cached tokens.
# TYPE vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total counter
vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{engine="0",model_name="m"} 2.647024e+06
# HELP vllm:num_preemptions_total Cumulative number of preemption from the engine.
# TYPE vllm:num_preemptions_total counter
vllm:num_preemptions_total{engine="0",model_name="m"} 7.0
# HELP vllm:prompt_tokens_total Number of prefill tokens processed.
# TYPE vllm:prompt_tokens_total counter
vllm:prompt_tokens_total{engine="0",model_name="m"} 3.310655e+06
# HELP vllm:generation_tokens_total Number of generation tokens processed.
# TYPE vllm:generation_tokens_total counter
vllm:generation_tokens_total{engine="0",model_name="m"} 27072.0
# HELP vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds Histogram of time_per_output_token_seconds per request.
# TYPE vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds histogram
vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket{engine="0",le="0.01",model_name="m"} 90.0
vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket{engine="0",le="0.025",model_name="m"} 180.0
vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket{engine="0",le="0.05",model_name="m"} 240.0
vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket{engine="0",le="0.1",model_name="m"} 249.0
vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket{engine="0",le="+Inf",model_name="m"} 250.0
vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_count{engine="0",model_name="m"} 250.0
vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_sum{engine="0",model_name="m"} 12.5
# HELP vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds Histogram of time to first token in seconds.
# TYPE vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds histogram
vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{engine="0",le="+Inf",model_name="m"} 250.0
vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_count{engine="0",model_name="m"} 250.0
vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_sum{engine="0",model_name="m"} 99.5
# HELP http_requests_total Total number of requests by method, status and handler.
# TYPE http_requests_total counter
http_requests_total{handler="/v1/chat/completions",method="POST",status="2xx"} 245.0
http_requests_total{handler="/v1/chat/completions",method="POST",status="5xx"} 3.0
